confidence_notes: I ran six web searches: one for the RBA rate and five for prices. The food and drink searches found no Mendoza-specific aggregated figures for the current period. Beer, cappuccino, inexpensive meal and mid-range dinner anchors are based on Argentina-wide Preciosmundi averages for 2026 (about USD 3.5 domestic beer, USD 3.5 cappuccino, USD 14.5 budget meal, USD 55 three-course dinner for two). I adjusted these slightly for Mendoza, which is not as expensive as Buenos Aires but is a tourist-oriented wine city. Other sources I found were older or inconsistent, and some travel-budget pages gave implausible outliers, which I ignored. No current Mendoza cocktail or restaurant wine-by-the-glass prices were found. Cocktail is set at roughly 1.8x the beer price and wine glass at roughly 1.3x. Wine glass is also informed by a general Argentina guide range of USD 4-8. All four accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Mendoza's hostel and hotel market. I did not search accommodation prices or inspect any listings. Argentine peso inflation and exchange-rate shifts make USD prices volatile. The FX figure comes from the RBA exchange-rate page via search results; I did not open the page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Argentina-wide 2026 restaurant price averages (Preciosmundi) were used as the base. Buenos Aires is about 11% above that national average, and Mendoza is placed slightly below Buenos Aires and near the national level. It is a mid-sized tourist and wine-region city in a similar price tier to Córdoba or Salta.
